course_title_en: Code & AI Fluency: Learning to Read Technical Work
course_title_zh: 代码与 AI 祛魅：学会读懂技术工作
course_promise_en: For non-engineers who work with programmers and AI agents: reduce the information gap, read the work trail, and know what evidence to ask for. Current release: orientation plus Part 1 foundations.
course_promise_zh: 给需要和程序员、AI agent（AI 代理）协作的人：减少技术信息差，读懂工作痕迹，知道该追问什么证据。当前开放入门章与卷一。

course_sources.name: MIT 6.100L
course_sources.fit_en: Course-level reference for computational thinking and Python as a first medium; its syllabus and reading trail point to the Guttag textbook/code materials for deeper study.
course_sources.fit_zh: 课程级参考：借鉴它用 Python 承载计算思维的顺序；顺着课程表深挖到 Guttag 教材和配套代码。

course_sources.name: Harvard CS50P
course_sources.fit_en: Course-level reference for beginner Python sequencing; individual links still require lesson-level review.
course_sources.fit_zh: 课程级参考：借鉴 Python 入门的组织顺序；具体页面是否外链，仍需逐课审核。

course_sources.name: Harvard CS50x
course_sources.fit_en: Course-level reference for breadth and expectation setting around what CS contains.
course_sources.fit_zh: 课程级参考：用于校准 CS 的范围感和学习预期。

course_sources.name: Stanford CS106A
course_sources.fit_en: Course-level reference for beginner program-design order and small-step problem solving.
course_sources.fit_zh: 课程级参考：借鉴入门程序设计里的小步拆题方式。

course_sources.name: MIT Missing Semester
course_sources.fit_en: Course-level reference for tools that traditional CS courses often leave implicit; lesson placement requires page-level review.
course_sources.fit_zh: 课程级参考：补上传统 CS 课常隐含的工具素养；具体页面要逐课审核后再放。

course_sources.name: Composing Programs
course_sources.focus_zh: 抽象能力与 AI 时代代码阅读
course_sources.fit_en: Course-level reference for framing CS as a broad field and for updating introductory programming in the AI era.
course_sources.fit_zh: 课程级参考：借鉴它对 CS 范围和 AI 时代编程入门的开场处理。

course_sources.name: Guttag text/code
course_sources.fit_en: Companion source for MIT's introductory computation sequence. Useful for chapter order, code density, and exercise style; not copied into lesson prose or problems.
course_sources.fit_zh: MIT 入门计算课程的配套资料。用于研究章节顺序、代码密度和题型风格；不复制原文和题目。

stages.milestone_en: You can spot a missing piece of evidence before accepting AI-assisted work.
stages.milestone_zh: 你能在接收 AI 辅助交付之前，看出缺了哪块证据。

stages.title_zh: 计算思维与 Python 基础
stages.milestone_en: You can read and trace basic Python.
stages.milestone_zh: 你能读懂基础 Python 代码，并一步步跟出它会做什么。

stages.title_zh: 写出真正能用的小程序
stages.milestone_en: You can independently write a working 50–100 line script.
stages.milestone_zh: 你能独立写出 50–100 行、真的能跑的脚本。

stages.milestone_en: You can follow engineering conversations — and make directional judgments about a small system's design.
stages.milestone_zh: 你能跟上工程对话，也能对一个小系统的设计做出方向性判断。

stages.title_zh: 跨语言阅读直觉与毕业项目
stages.milestone_en: You can guess what unfamiliar code does — and you've designed and shipped a tool of your own, design doc first.
stages.milestone_zh: 你能猜出陌生编程语言里的代码在干什么——并且先写设计、后动手，交付一个自己的工具。
